title: Adaptive Triggering for Bias Correction in LLM Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2608.25379v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Chain-of-thought prompting can expose and amplify demographic stereotypes within an LLM's intermediate reasoning and create a failure mode that final-answer debiasing alone cannot address. Mitigating such bias during generation presents a fundamental timing problem: intervening too late allows biased reasoning to propagate, while unnecessarily intervening can disrupt otherwise correct reasoning. Existing approaches largely avoid this decision by either evaluating completed reasoning chains post hoc or intervening at predetermined steps, leaving open when a developing reasoning trajectory provides sufficient evidence to warrant correction. We formulate this decision as an online change-point detection problem. A per-step bias signal updates a CUSUM statistic and a targeted correction is injected only when accumulated evidence crosses a detector-specific threshold calibrated on held-out data. translated_title: 大语言模型推理中偏差修正的自适应触发机制
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.25379v1 公告类型：新论文 摘要：思维链提示可以暴露并放大大型语言模型中间推理过程中的社会人口统计刻板印象，并产生一种仅靠最终答案去偏无法解决的失败模式。在生成过程中减轻这种偏差面临一个根本性的时机问题：干预过晚会让有偏差的推理传播开来，而不必要的干预则会扰乱原本正确的推理。现有方法大多通过事后评估完整推理链或在预定步骤进行干预来回避这一决策，但未解决何时一个正在发展的推理轨迹能提供足够证据以需要进行修正的问题。我们将此决策形式化为一个在线变化点检测问题。每步的偏差信号更新一个CUSUM统计量，并且仅当累积证据超过在保留数据上校准的特定检测器阈值时，才注入针对性的修正。我们通过一个白盒s实例化该框架。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于在线变化点检测的自适应触发机制，通过CUSUM统计量动态判断何时干预思维链推理中的偏差，避免了过早或过晚干预的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an adaptive triggering mechanism based on online change-point detection, using a CUSUM statistic to dynamically decide when to intervene in chain-of-thought reasoning bias, avoiding issues of premature or delayed intervention.
